title: Watermark
description: Add specific text or patterns to the page.
whenToUse:
- Use when the page needs to be watermarked to identify the copyright.
- Suitable for preventing information theft.

examples.name: Basic
Multi-line watermark
examples.description: Use `content` to set an array of strings and `WatermarkText` to specify multi-line text watermark content with custom font styles per line.

examples.name: Image watermark
examples.description: Specify the image address via `image`. To ensure that the image is high definition and not stretched, set the width and height, and upload at least twice the width and height of the logo image address.

examples.name: Custom configuration
examples.description: Preview the watermark effect by configuring custom parameters.

examples.name: Modal or Drawer

rows: The width of the watermark, the default value of `content` is its own width
The height of the watermark, the default value of `content` is its own height
Pass the watermark to the pop-up component such as Modal, Drawer
When the watermark is drawn, the rotation Angle, unit `°`
The z-index of the appended watermark element
Image source, it is recommended to export 2x or 3x image, high priority (support base64 format)
The offset of the watermark from the upper left corner of the container. The default is `gap/2`
Callback when the watermark is removed by DOM mutation
